mentions.name: humancrm.io
mentions.description: A CRM built for relationship-based selling, designed for independents and founders who find mainstream AI-heavy sales automation CRMs unsuitable.
mentions.problem: The current crop of CRMs are going all in on AI and sales automation and are not designed for relationship sellers.
mentions.audience: Independents, solopreneurs, professionals, and many founders or CEOs
mentions.source_excerpt: I've always been a relationship seller but the current crop of CRMs are not designed for me. So I've built https://humancrm.io/ to scratch my own itch.

evidence.value: I've always been a relationship seller but the current crop of CRMs are not designed for me. So I've built https://humancrm.io/ to scratch my own itch.
